entrega: guia e referencias de logica, sem projeto Godot criado

testes_portaveis.saida: PASS: permanent HUD, purchases/select, formation-preserving swaps, reserve actions avoid field rebuilds, equipment labels/conservation, invalid and combat actions, single reward collection.
PASS: local checkpoints, exact RNG, two-slot corruption fallback, schema/capacity/UID/cell/items validation, no native IDs/replay, combat rollback and pending reward, payload <4 KB.
PASS: 12 base-health/damage profiles, star/item growth, all 8 reserve slots, full-capacity swaps, item conservation, field-only synergies, healer, attack cadence and delayed floating-damage input.
PASS: atomic drag/swap/sale, 8 bench slots, range 1/2/infinity; 60 crowded combats, 1060 exclusive steps, 15015 attacks, 85 safe jumps, 370 released squares. Game never opened.
PASS: 45 grid timelines remain deterministic, including every reservation, position, range, hit, heal, death and outcome; persistent formations unchanged.

verificacoes.dados: 14 tipos, 12 jogaveis, 2 mobs, 15 encontros, probabilidades, juros e casas exclusivas dos adversarios conferidos
verificacoes.referencias: 11 arquivos copiados e comparados byte a byte com a fonte consultada
verificacoes.documentos: links locais resolvidos e UTF-8 sem caracteres de substituicao
verificacoes.svg: XML valido; diagrama documental, sem validacao visual dentro de jogo
verificacoes.instalacao_antiga: GameAssembly.dll e resources.assets conferidos contra o recibo instalado, sem alteracao

limites: Nao ha implementacao Godot, scripts GDScript ou arte final nesta entrega.
2D/2.5D e pixel art sao propostas discutidas, nao estilo final confirmado.
Michael Jackson e requisito futuro, com pendencias de balanceamento e sem implementacao.
Testes executam apenas a logica JS propria; nao certificam estabilidade, aparencia ou FPS no Godot.
Nenhum asset, DLL ou executavel do cliente antigo foi incluido.
